practicalCriteria: Each labour, material, travel and overhead line states its basis
One margin type is named, and the price is calculated with the matching formula, with the calculation visible
The rounding rule is stated, the minimum charge is checked, and any decision below it is recorded with its reason
The margin on the final rounded price is recalculated and compared with the target
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
evidenceRequired: source of each rate, cost and hours figure
